run_compare_benchmarks: run compare_bench.py with two benchmark executables or JSON files to generate a difference report
run_check_inputs: run check_inputs to validate two benchmark inputs and diagnose abnormalities in flags
run_run_or_load_benchmark: run gbench.util.run_or_load_benchmark to execute a benchmark executable or load a JSON result file
run_generate_difference_report: run gbench.report.generate_difference_report to produce a diff report between two benchmark JSON results
run_classify_input_file: run classify_input_file to determine whether an input is a benchmark executable or JSON file
